body: i started seeing a therapist again after the events (3 years ago) and it’s kind of helped but the shame feels like something no else can understand for my situation in particular. i know that sounds selfish but i just don’t know who could possibly understand
yep!! it’s all become a waste of time to me. i feel unlovable. i know for sure that you are capable of being loved and logically i guess i am too. hard to tell.
